review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people believe that only students who show the best academic result will be rewarded by their school, while others argue that it is more essential to reward students who show improvement. Personally, I think that both groups of students deserve to reward.

Admittedly, it is undeniable that students who have the best performance need to be reward. Since students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve to praise and privilege for it. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and also propel towards overall academic gains in the future. Moreover, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. Thus students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition and it is enable for them to achieve success in later life.

However, I strongly believe that school also needs to reward students who show improvement. If only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, others might think that their efforts is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. This leads to prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened so students gradually lose the incentive to study. By emphasizing improvement, school can encouraged all students to be diligent in their studies and help them to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves regardless of how well they have been or are performing. This might teach them that the constant desire to outdo themselves even benefit themselves more than the competition determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that students who show the best performance and others who show improvement should be rewarded by their school.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận trên nguồn ảnh đủ trang.

review.overall: Em triển khai đủ hai chính sách, kết luận nhất quán với mở bài và nêu được bốn nhánh ý của dàn bài. Chuỗi ở Body 2 từ 'efforts is futile' đến 'lose the incentive to study' có hướng lập luận đúng. Tuy nhiên, các khung 'deserve to reward', 'deserve to praise and privilege', 'This leads to prone to feeling' cho thấy em ghép động từ và tính từ chưa kiểm soát; Body 1 còn dùng 'it is enable for them'. Mức vận dụng nội dung đạt nhưng độ chính xác ngôn ngữ yếu. Em cần viết lại các câu đó, tự xác định chức năng từng từ rồi đối chiếu bản chữa. Hai Body đều có đủ hai nhánh và em đã dùng “Moreover” ở Body 1, đổi nghĩa sang lợi ích tiến bộ ở Body 2. Tuy nhiên, “Since” và “If” chỉ mở quan hệ trong lý do đầu; em chưa báo rõ đó là ý hỗ trợ thứ nhất sau câu chủ đề.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
